def get_layer(r, c, rs, re, cs, ce):
    return min(r-rs, re-r, c-cs, ce-c)

def analyze_layer_colors(rs, re, cs, ce, grid):
    layer_colors = {}
    for r in range(rs, re+1):
        for c in range(cs, ce+1):
            if grid[r][c] > 0:

c2_colors = analyze_layer_colors(*C2, orig)

def swap_layers(rs, re, cs, ce, colors_in_orig, output_grid):
